run_basis: Fresh independent CPU computation over a frozen product and extraction protocol. Download records a scoped source snapshot; show, check and export read that snapshot.

uniprot.query: reviewed:true AND cc_pharmaceutical:* AND (accession:P20333 OR accession:P01308 OR accession:P00750 OR accession:P06280)

dailymed.terms_scope: Retain only the declared label paragraphs. DailyMed labels are company submissions; this protocol assigns no reuse licence to them.

snapshot.format: SNAPSHOT_JSON string literal in the listed package file
snapshot.route: download fetches the search, individual UniProt entries and selected SPLs, then overwrites this committed scoped snapshot. Offline runs read it.
snapshot.fetch_record: UTC retrieval time, exact URL, response byte length and source version

counted_unit: One named therapeutic entity, not one accession or source record.
aggregation_rule: An entity states a field when at least one selected source record states it. Construct definition requires construct and host in the same source record. Construct/host gaps are reported by entity and source.

modality.rule: Count the product's explicit biological class in its own label. A reviewed UniProt protein entry with a named pharmaceutical product and protein name states the broad protein modality. A drug target cross-reference does not.

construct.rule: Count product-specific components, assembly or sequence alteration in the selected record passage. A product name, indication or unspecified glycosylation difference is insufficient. Record whether a multi-chain assembly and its parts are distinguished.

expression_system.rule: Count only a named production host explicitly linked to the product. The UniProt organism is the native source organism, not a production host.

intended_function.rule: Count an explicit product action in the pharmaceutical annotation or mechanism section. Disease indication and the endogenous protein's FUNCTION comment do not fill this field.

definition_rule: A source record defines a construct only when that same record states its modality, product-specific construct and production host. A modality alone is not a construct. An entity with neither construct nor host is not defined. Function remains a separate fourth field.
comparison_rule: Compare normalized values only where two source records state the same field. One source's silence is a coverage difference, not a disagreement.
excluded_by_design: A defined construct is not thereby developable or a therapeutic candidate.
The number of stated fields does not rank the therapeutic entities.
An unstated field in a selected record is not absent from the underlying science.
Native protein annotations and target cross-references do not describe a drug construct.
